name: Zao Asian Cafe Yakisoba Noodles with Seared Chicken (Mild)
brandOrRestaurant: Zao Asian Cafe (Draper / Lehi / South Jordan)
whyItWorks: Tender wheat yakisoba noodles wok-tossed with lean chicken breast in mild sweet soy sauce. Satisfies noodle cravings without spicy oils or raw roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose yakisoba noodle base with chicken breast and sweet teriyaki sauce. Do NOT add wok veggies (cabbage/onions) or chili crunch.
